title: DynamoDB resilience — PITR + Streams + stub stream Lambda
topic: DynamoDB PITR, on-demand backups, Streams view types, Lambda event source mapping, global tables awareness, DynamoDB vs Aurora for GSA wiki counters
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-18-dynamodb-resilience.md and night-18-lab-dynamodb-setup scripts. Answer without peeking at night-18-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: An operator accidentally deletes items from saa-study-gsa-wiki-views. PITR is enabled. What is the correct recovery action?

options.A: Run restore-table-to-point-in-time to a new table name within the 35-day window
options.B: Enable the stream TRIM_HORIZON starting position to replay deleted rows in place
options.C: Call UpdateItem on each missing pageId with ConditionExpression attribute_not_exists
options.D: Disable PITR, run on-demand backup, and import the snapshot over the same table name

questions.question: night-18-lab enables StreamViewType NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES on saa-study-gsa-wiki-views. The stub Lambda logs old and new viewCount on MODIFY. Which view type would hide the previous count?

options.A: OLD_IMAGE only — emits the item before the change but not the new image after the update
options.B: KEYS_ONLY — emits partition key fields only with no attribute payload in the record
options.C: NEW_IMAGE only — emits the item after the change but not the previous image before it
options.D: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES — includes both old and new images on every stream event type by default

questions.question: You create a DynamoDB stream event source mapping with StartingPosition=LATEST. You then run -BumpView on wiki/iceland. An earlier bump from before the mapping never invoked Lambda. Why?

options.A: PITR must be disabled while DynamoDB stream event source mappings remain active on the table
options.B: On-demand tables cannot emit MODIFY stream events until provisioned capacity mode is enabled
options.C: LATEST delivers only records after the mapping is created — prior stream data is skipped
options.D: Lambda polls an SQS queue behind the stream and the completion queue was empty at mapping time

questions.question: GSA prod wiki-api increments page views with UpdateItem. night-18-lab uses ADD viewCount :inc. Why is ADD preferred over read-then-SET for hot counters?

options.A: ADD requires a TransactWriteItems call and therefore guarantees cross-table consistency always
options.B: ADD only works on sort-key attributes, which prevents hot partition mistakes on pageId keys
options.C: ADD triggers Kinesis Data Streams automatically for analytics export of every counter increment
options.D: ADD atomically increments without a separate GetItem — avoids lost updates under concurrency

questions.question: A stream processor Lambda fails mid-batch. DynamoDB stream event source mappings retry. What design property keeps audit logging safe?

options.A: Writing the same log line twice is fine — the handler prints idempotent summaries only
options.B: Set batch size to 1 and disable retries on the DynamoDB stream event source mapping entirely
options.C: Use FIFO SQS between the stream and Lambda to force exactly-once delivery of every record
options.D: Switch StreamViewType to KEYS_ONLY so retries carry no duplicate attribute payload at all

questions.question: Compare tonight's stub stream Lambda to Night 17 saa-study-gsa-stats-uploader. What is the trigger difference?

options.A: Both use EventBridge schedules that fire every minute against their target functions
options.B: Night 18 reacts to DynamoDB row changes; Night 17 polls SQS completion messages
options.C: Night 18 uses Aurora logical replication slots; Night 17 uses DynamoDB Streams only
options.D: Both use API Gateway HTTP API synchronous invoke paths for every incoming request

questions.question: Global Ski Atlas needs wiki read/write in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 with local low latency. Tables are DynamoDB. Which feature fits?

options.A: Aurora Global Database for WikiPages items stored as JSON rows in PostgreSQL
options.B: RDS read replica in eu-west-1 attached directly to the wiki DynamoDB table endpoint
options.C: DynamoDB global tables with multi-Region active-active replication for local access
options.D: S3 Cross-Region Replication on the DynamoDB table export bucket only for DR reads

questions.question: A Lambda in Night 9 private subnets calls DynamoDB in the same Region. NAT Gateway charges are high on GetItem traffic. What reduces DynamoDB egress cost?

options.A: Enable DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) in the public subnet to cache GetItem responses
options.B: Move the table to Aurora Serverless v2 in the same VPC to avoid DynamoDB API calls
options.C: Attach an internet gateway directly to the private subnet route table for DynamoDB
options.D: Add a DynamoDB gateway VPC endpoint and route DynamoDB prefix-list traffic locally

questions.question: night-18-lab uses PAY_PER_REQUEST on saa-study-gsa-wiki-views. Wiki traffic spikes unpredictably on powder days. Why match on-demand billing here?

options.A: On-demand scales read/write capacity per request without provisioning RCU/WCU upfront
options.B: On-demand removes the need for partition keys on hot counter items stored in the wiki table
options.C: On-demand automatically enables DynamoDB global tables in a second Region for every new table
options.D: On-demand requires PITR to stay disabled so continuous backup cost stays predictable monthly

questions.question: You need centralized nightly backups for DynamoDB wiki tables, Aurora resort_stats, and EBS volumes under one retention policy. Which service?

options.A: DynamoDB PITR alone — it backs up all AWS data stores in the account automatically
options.B: AWS Backup with a plan that selects resources by tag or ARN (Night 19 topic preview)
options.C: CloudTrail with data events enabled on every DynamoDB table stream shard for restore
options.D: RDS automated backup window extended to 35 days and applied to all AWS services

questions.question: Two Regions write the same item key in a global table within the same second. What conflict resolution applies?

options.A: DynamoDB rejects the second write with ConditionalCheckFailedException in both Regions always
options.B: The write from the Region with the lexicographically lower table ARN wins automatically for that item
options.C: Last writer wins per item — eventual consistency across Regions for conflicting updates
options.D: Strongly consistent reads block all conflicting writes until a global distributed lock expires

questions.question: resort_stats monthly_runs needs SQL JOIN reports. wiki/iceland viewCount needs millions of atomic increments. Where should each live per GSA split?

options.A: Both in Aurora — use JSONB columns for high-volume wiki view counter increments
options.B: Both in DynamoDB — model JOINs as multiple Query calls for each reporting request
options.C: S3 Parquet for both — Athena replaces DynamoDB and Aurora for counters and JOINs
options.D: Aurora for relational resort_stats; DynamoDB for hot wiki view counter increments

questions.question: The stream processor IAM role needs dynamodb:GetRecords on the stream ARN. What else must the role allow for Lambda to emit logs?

options.A: logs:CreateLogGroup, logs:CreateLogStream, and logs:PutLogEvents on CloudWatch Logs
options.B: ec2:CreateNetworkInterface for DynamoDB Streams ENI attachment inside the private VPC subnets
options.C: dynamodb:UpdateItem on the source wiki table for every processed stream record batch item
options.D: sqs:SendMessage to mirror each stream batch into the Night 13 Iceland completion queue path

questions.question: Maximum continuous backup window for DynamoDB PITR on a single-Region table is how long?

options.A: 7 days — same as the default RDS automated backup retention period for DB instances
options.B: 35 days — exam standard maximum retention for DynamoDB PITR continuous backups
options.C: 14 days — matches the maximum SQS standard queue message retention period on queues
options.D: 365 days — available only when AWS Backup premium tier is enabled on the AWS account

questions.question: night-18-lab teardown deletes saa-study-gsa-wiki-views. Prod WikiPages is untouched. A teammate asks whether teardown affects Night 17 Aurora. What is true?

options.A: Aurora writer endpoint stops whenever any DynamoDB table in the same account is deleted
options.B: Night 17 stats-uploader loses its VPC ENI when the wiki-views study table is removed
options.C: Nothing — Night 18 study table and stream Lambda are independent of Night 16/17 Aurora
options.D: SQS completion queue is deleted automatically together with the DynamoDB study table teardown
